name: rema-2m
title: REMA v2 2 m mosaic tiles (PGC)
description: Antarctic polar stereographic; 100 km supertiles split 2 x 2 into 50 km subtiles, each delivered as a 50.2 km footprint (100 m overlap on every side). IDs are {super_row}_{super_col}_{sub_row}_{sub_col}.

list.origin: PGC REMA v2.0 2 m mosaic tiles (s3://pgc-opendata-dems/rema/mosaics/v2.0/2m/), as indexed by mdsumner/rema-ovr

provenance.derived_from: placement of every 2 m source in mdsumner/rema-ovr REMA-2m_dem_ovr.vrt (gdalbuildvrt over the PGC tiles), tools/fixtures-vrt.py
notes: Overlapping tiles: each 50 km subtile is delivered 100 m larger on every side (25100 px at 2 m), so neighbours share 200 m. This is a real scheme the linter should flag ('footprints overlap: every point in the overlap has two tiles') while still describing it exactly.

7 of the 5788 tiles (61_15_1_1, 61_15_1_2, 61_15_2_1, 61_15_2_2, 62_15_1_1, 62_15_2_1, 63_13_2_1) are 25101 px, one pixel more than the rule, extending 2 m further east and south. Recorded as known differences in the fixtures.

The PGC 10 m and 32 m mosaics tile by 100 km supertile instead (IDs {super_row}_{super_col}): 10 m tiles are 10020 px (100 m pad), 32 m tiles 3131 px, a 96 m pad, because 32 m does not divide 100 m. Some edge tiles are half height. Not expressed here: one spec per tiling for now.
The supertile/subtile split is expressed as ID field expressions over a 50 km lattice; nesting the 100 km supertile as its own tiling would also work.

alignment.note: every GIBS EPSG:3031 pixel is a whole block of REMA 2 m pixels (the origins differ by 1094304 m, a multiple of 2); the tiles don't nest (REMA 50 km cells with 100 m pads vs 512-pixel GIBS tiles)
